fusions.name: Gagging Wrap
fusions.desc: Throws a musk-soaked wrap over the face of the first enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistances and leaving it [Suppressed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Washing Line
fusions.desc: Strings a musk-soaked line 6 tiles long for 8 seconds that deals 11 damage to each enemy crossing it and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Cover Scent
fusions.desc: Draws a musk-soaked shroud over you and every ally near you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the shroud breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Into the Weave
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 10% poison resistance.
